title: Solidify Iran Sanctions Act of 2025
committees: S-Banking, Housing, and Urban Affairs Committee: Referred To 2025-05-06 || H-Oversight and Government Reform Committee: Referred To 2025-03-03 || H-Judiciary Committee: Referred To 2025-03-03 || H-Ways and Means Committee: Referred To 2025-03-03 || H-Financial Services Committee: Referred To 2025-03-03 || H-Foreign Affairs Committee: Referred To 2025-03-03
latest_action: Received in the Senate and Read twice and referred to the Committee on Banking, Housing, and Urban Affairs.
summary: Solidify Iran Sanctions Act of 2025 This bill eliminates a sunset clause in the Iran Sanctions Act of 1996, thereby making the act permanent. The Iran Sanctions Act requires the President, with some exceptions, to impose sanctions on certain individuals or entities engaged in specified transactions related to Iran's energy sector or Iran's efforts to acquire or develop certain weapons (such as chemical, biological, or nuclear weapons).

journey.note: Passed the House; waiting on the Senate
